visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a panning shot inside a brightly lit Japanese drugstore. The shelves are densely packed with small boxed medicines, vitamins, and healthcare products in varied packaging. A large yellow and pink text overlay appears in the center. (2) The scene shifts to the cosmetics and skincare section. Displays of lotions, facial cleansers, and beauty tools are visible under cool-toned, bright indoor lighting. Text panels explain the difference between drugstore types. (3) A close-up shot shows a person's hand with three different shades of lipstick or eyeshadow swatched on the back of the hand. The background is a blurred interior of a shopping mall. (4) A rapid montage follows, showing interiors of 'Loft' and other beauty specialty stores featuring modern, minimalist aesthetics and wide aisles. (5) Graphic screens appear, listing various Japanese store logos like Loft, @cosme, and Matsumoto Kiyoshi against clean white backgrounds. (6) The final phase shows a pink background with a large QR code in the center and social media logos at the bottom, concluding with the 'Japanuts' brand icon.
